# Rapier 3D

Vendored `@dimforge/rapier3d-compat` **0.21.0**, from the official npm package.
`rapier.mjs` is its original ES module with embedded WebAssembly. It loads only
when Mall furniture physics initializes. No external CDN or npm install is needed
to run this repository.

Source: https://github.com/dimforge/rapier
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@dimforge/rapier3d-compat/v/0.21.0
Licence: Apache-2.0, retained in `LICENSE` and build-generated third-party notices.
